name: Turkish motorway and bridge tolls (KGM)
law: Karayollarında Geçiş Ücretlerinin Belirlenmesi ve Uygulanmasına Dair Yönetmelik; KGM's 2025 tariffs. Bridges (15 Temmuz Şehitler, Fatih Sultan Mehmet, Osmangazi, Yavuz Sultan Selim) per passage either way; motorways by entry and exit station. By KGM class: 2 (two axles of 3.20 m or more wheelbase), 3 (three axles), 4 (four and five axles), 5 (six or more), excluding 20% KDV (VAT). Trucks may not use 15 Temmuz Şehitler or FSM (UKOME decision) but pay their tariff if they do. Bridges placed at their main span, stations at their toll booths (else the motorway junction of their name) in OpenStreetMap (extract of 2026-11-08); 29 stations OSM doesn't name aren't placed, a trip from or to one priced from the next placed station. The Osmangazi bridge is charged at its own tariff, Gebze–Bursa's prices taken without it; Kuzey Çevre's tickets include the Yavuz Sultan Selim bridge, which isn't charged again on them. Built from the Internet Archive's copies of the 2025 pages. KGM's tariffs from 13 January 2025 (the 2025 list, its files named ADO Aydın–Denizli, ANO Ankara–Niğde, MAÇ Menemen–Aliağa–Çandarlı, ÇOK Malkara–Çanakkale, GOİ Gebze–Orhangazi–İzmir), as the Internet Archive kept them in January 2025.
vehicles: Trucks of two or more axles (KGM classes 2 to 5)
tolled_roads: The 15 Temmuz Şehitler, Fatih Sultan Mehmet, Yavuz Sultan Selim and Osmangazi bridges; O-4 Anadolu Otoyolu (Çamlıca – Akıncı), O-32 İzmir – Çeşme, O-31 İzmir – Aydın (Işıkkent – Aydın Batı), O-52/O-53 Çukurova (Adana Doğu – Gaziantep Batı), O-52 Çukurova (Gaziantep Doğu – Şanlıurfa), O-21/O-51 Çukurova (Niğde – Mersin – Adana Batı), O-3 Avrupa Otoyolu (Mahmutbey – Edirne), O-7 Kuzey Marmara Avrupa (Kınalı – Odayeri), O-7 Kuzey Marmara Anadolu (Kurtköy – Akyazı), O-33 Menemen – Aliağa – Çandarlı, O-21 Ankara – Niğde, O-6 Malkara – Çanakkale (1915 Çanakkale Köprüsü), O-31 Aydın – Denizli, O-5 Gebze – Orhangazi – Bursa (Osmangazi Köprüsü), O-5 Bursa – İzmir, O-7 Yavuz Sultan Selim Köprüsü ve Kuzey Çevre Otoyolu.
